tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one article or news brief, as Markdown with front matter (title, url, date, author, tags, translation link) and its references. format summary gives the front matter and summary only; outline gives the section headings. Falls back to French when the piece has no English edition, and

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: A digest of recent pieces grouped by section, featured pieces first: what happened in Morocco today, this week or this month according to The Moorish Times.

tools.name: site_map
tools.description: What the magazine covers: sections with counts and URLs, the most used tags, featured pieces, author pages and series.

tools.name: series
tools.description: Running stories the desk follows as one series, such as the 2026 elections or the Sahara. Without a slug, lists every series with its count and latest piece; with one, gives every piece in reading order, oldest first.

tools.name: timeline
tools.description: Every piece on a tag or topic in date order, oldest first, to follow how a story unfolded. Marks the first and latest mention.

tools.name: related
tools.description: Pieces that share tags and section with a given piece, the closest first.

tools.name: compare_editions
tools.description: Both editions of one piece aligned block by block, with both URLs. For readers comparing the languages or checking a translation.

tools.name: get_sources
tools.description: A piece's references, outbound links and image credits, plus a ready citation of the piece itself in APA, MLA or Chicago style.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Tags with the number of pieces carrying each, most used first, named in the asked edition with both names in the data. Both names are accepted wherever a tag filter is.

tools.name: send_to_newsroom
tools.description: Send the newsroom a story tip, a correction, a rights or advertising request, or another message, on the user's behalf and with their consent. message holds the user's own words; reply_to is their email, for when they want an answer. tools.name: report_missing
tools.description: Tell The Moorish Times about a task a reader wanted that this server, the site or the API could not do. It records the task only, never personal data.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "send_to_newsroom" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: send_to_newsroom, report_missing · Public sink: related, send_to_newsroom · Destructive: fetch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: send_to_newsroom, report_missing · Public sink: related, send_to_newsroom · Destructive: fetch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
